invention.name: Bad Idea RPG
invention.description: A shoulder-fired rocket launcher with visible flying rockets, smoky exhaust, punchy recoil, and explosive impacts that breach prison walls and the gate.
invention.usage: Aim at the gate or a prison wall and press F or click. Fire again after the reload click. Walk through your breach; stand back from explosions.
limitations: Automatic reload takes about three-quarters of a second.
Nearby explosions can knock you backward.
Rockets fly straight without homing; missed rockets burn out after four seconds.
